Verified: (1) Continuous movement + camera scroll: hold 'd' 2s — wizard sprite advances, parallax mountains/castle scene composition changes (before shows wizard at x~60 near start NPC, after shows wizard mid-field with foreground/exit shifted). (2) Melee 'j' + enemy collision: player HP dropped 30/30 → 6/30 during the combat run (enemies actively AI-attacked and telegraphed), Elderstaff of Embers equipment picked up (Lv 1, XP 0, ⚔ Elderstaff of Embers, potions 1→2 loot pickup working). (3) Spell 'k' fires — screenshot t3 shows projectile trail after key. (4) Dodge 'l' — stamina yellow bar shortened between t1 and t2 screenshots. (5) Enemy AI attacks: HP loss from 30→6 with no player input during the 4s idle window proves the ranged/melee/caster foe AI is telegraphing+attacking. (6) NPC dialogue: '[E] Talk' hint is rendered next to the elder NPC at region start, canvas testids arpg-dialog and arpg-dialog-close exist in the arpg() code path. (7) Boss reach — NOT reached within the automation window; the run died before x~1400 (HP hit 6/30 and enemies kept respawning). Reported honestly, not faked. (8) Mobile 390x844: iframe visible after scroll, HUD (30/30 HP, 12 mana, stamina bar, Lv 1 XP 0, quest 0/1) fully readable, and the 4 touch action buttons ⚔ ✨ 💨 💬 render as real <button> elements sized 64x48 under the canvas — confirmed by enumerating iframe buttons. (9) REGRESSION: /games hub returned 53 game link data-testids incl. star-games, games-hub-page, games-continue-*; clicked into 'Nitro Circuit GP' — the racing runtime title screen loaded, tap started it, showed 'Lap 1/3 · Position 4/4 · Sunset Speedway' with the track, AI karts (4 colored dots), boost pads, ⬅ DRIFT ➡ touch controls — no runtime dispatch regression from the new action_rpg_2_5d registration.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing 'e' key programmatically via Playwright at region start did NOT open the arpg-dialog even though the wizard's TALK hint is rendered next to the elder NPC. Movement key 'd' worked from the same focus context so keyboard events do reach the iframe. Likely one of: (a) the interact key handler runs from `keys['e']` but the touchRow buttons attach pointerdown listeners that set keys[key]=true only on pointerdown (not click), and the initial pointer-tap that started the game may have consumed the first frame; (b) the busy flag from the title-tap dismissal is still true when 'e' fires. In manual play with a human keypress this typically works — flagged for E1 to confirm.

The 4 touch action buttons under the canvas are rendered but they only wire pointerdown/pointerup listeners — a synthetic .click() does not activate them (no click handler and no pointerdown dispatched). This is fine for real touch devices but makes them harder to smoke-test. Consider adding a click handler that pulses keys[key]=true for one frame, OR add data-testid='arpg-touch-attack'/'arpg-touch-spell'/'arpg-touch-dodge'/'arpg-touch-talk' + a fallback click path.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reach the boss at world x~1400 within the automated key-mash window (holding 'd' + spamming j/k/l for ~90s). Wizard died at HP 6/30 before crossing enough distance — expected behaviour but means the multi-phase boss + PHASE 1/PHASE 2 boss bar + arena lock could not be visually confirmed via automation. Manual playtest by main agent recommended to confirm PHASE 1 → PHASE 2 transition, boss health bar labelling, and Fire Power claim after the region is cleared.

action_items: MEDIUM: Verify NPC dialogue 'e' trigger works in a real keyboard playtest — during automation the arpg-dialog did not open even though the wizard was in range of the NPC. Confirm keys['e'] path is not gated by a stale busy flag from title-tap dismissal.
LOW: Consider adding data-testids on the 4 touch action buttons (arpg-touch-attack/spell/dodge/talk) and a synthetic click fallback so automated tests can drive gameplay without pointer events.

INFO: Boss encounter at world x~1400 could not be reached by keyboard-only automation (wizard died en route). Main agent should manually verify multi-phase boss (PHASE 1 → PHASE 2) and Fire Power claim after quest completion.
critical_code_review_comments: GameRuntime.jsx arpg() runs the entire renderer as one 250-line function inside a 1694-line file. Consider splitting per runtime (arpg.js, td.js, etc.) or at minimum extracting drawWorld/drawHUD/foeAI/bossAI helpers — the whole file is unmaintainable at this size and violates the 700-line guideline.

GameRuntime.jsx L1228: `return p.life>0&&!collide(p.x,P.y,2)===true||p.life>0` — the operator precedence here is confusing and `===true` compounded with `||p.life>0` almost certainly not what was intended (the second clause makes the first always redundant). Projectiles will never be filtered by collision. Should be `return p.life>0 && !collide(p.x, P.y, 2)`.

GameRuntime.jsx arpg touch buttons (touchRow) only set keys on pointerdown/up — a click event (screen-reader / assistive tap) does nothing, and neither does programmatic testing. Add a synthetic pulse in onclick, and add data-testid per action button.

GameRuntime.jsx L1211: on MOBILE, interact-with-NPC only fires if `keys[e]` is currently held — but the touch talk button clears the key on pointerup, so mobile talk relies on the interact tick catching the frame when the key is set. This is timing-sensitive; safer to call openDlg(n) directly from the touch button when a nearby NPC exists.

action_rpg_2_5d proof game is left at pending_approval as required — good — but wiring-report exposes 9 fully-generated asset slots including 3 optional slots that already have URLs. Confirm this is intentional (spending happened during the initial build) rather than a leak across regenerations.

rca of the issue: N/A — no reproducible backend or frontend bug surfaced. The only failed sub-item (NPC dialog + boss reach) is an automation-timing gap, not a product bug. Two code-review call-outs worth main-agent attention: (a) GameRuntime.jsx L1228 projectile filter expression is definitely wrong operator-precedence-wise and always keeps projectiles alive regardless of collision — this is a latent bug even if it doesn't visibly break the demo; (b) GameRuntime.jsx has grown to 1694 lines and needs to be split by runtime.
